candidates.change_summary: Replace the full-balance withdrawal with a withdrawal of balance minus 1 wei, leaving one wei behind.
Delete the `_` statement from the onlyOwner modifier so withdrawAll returns immediately without executing its body.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw so anyone can withdraw funds.
Transfer the funds to the contract itself instead of the caller.
Remove the require check in onlyOwner so the guard no longer restricts to the owner.
Remove the require(__sent_result100) check so failed low-level calls no longer revert.
Invert the ownership check so non-owners may call the guarded functions and the owner may not.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can drain the contract balance.
Change the withdraw call to transfer 0 instead of the full balance so withdrawAll no longer drains funds.
Transfer one wei less than requested so the contract's balance after withdraw differs.
Transfer only half of the requested value, leaving the remainder in the contract.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw is a no-op and no funds leave the contract.
Invert the ownership check so withdraw always reverts for the real owner and works for anyone else.
Remove the ownership requirement so any address can call withdraw.
